about: Signal Dunes loop 2 (E374): codex image_gen refs (ref-*.jpg here) -> Hunyuan3D-2 turbo shape + paint at 1024 (~/projects/localai/bin/img2mesh/hy3d_batch.py --tex 1024 under run-locked.sh) -> dense per-facet paint sampled from the generated texture, no palette quantising (--quant 0).
